storage_budget.explanation: GU has twice the down payload for Granite4Tiny; only down is replicated. Whole-copy policy uses57 complete12tile backups=684extra tiles and cannot use4remaining tiles as another whole profile.

prior_theory.generic_RDA_superset: With the same688 physical tile locations, generic integral task-to-chip flow contains every compound profile assignment, even after imposing at most one tile per expert/chip and exact9task/channel input balance. Mean/p99 improvement over this baseline is impossible in the modeled resource costs.
prior_theory.whole_profile_necessary_availability: For every6-expert query to cover every omission color, at most5 experts may lack each color. Hence at least4*(64-5)=236 logical expert-profile incidences are necessary. Given64 baseprofiles, at least172 extra fullprofiles (2064extra tiles if stored as independent12tile copies) are necessary in this restricted4-profile family. A2profile-per-expert policy cannot give the universal guarantee even if every expert is copied.
prior_theory.distinction: The profile-incidence bound concerns independent complete stored profiles; selective shared-row replicas and generic replicated declustering evade this duplication cost. It is not a global lower bound beyond the canonical12tile and4omit-profile family.

native_costs: Every query executes72 ordinary128x512 GEMVs, one task/chip/expert;250ns each, all512B task inputs andFP32 outputs paid.5waves*28us+18uscommands+2ushost+2304nschannelinput+4608nsoutput=166912ns. No extra execution contexts or GU copies.
limitations: Whole-copy hot57 membership is a frequency baseline, with5 restarts and exact coordinate optimization of the second omit color; no global optimality or optimized membership claim.
Generic flow is deliberately given exactly the same fixed physical locations as compound, exposing the direct prior-art superset rather than handicapping placement.
Tile payload/pages are counted; allocator block padding, GGUF scales, unrelated weights and device capacity are not equated to payload.
No real model numeric or physical latency experiment; true released-checkpoint routes drive an ordinary-native-command arithmetic model.
Neither main plans nor theorem artifacts changed, and no heldout data was opened.
